newsitem.title: USA: NYSE to suspend, delist Prime Motor.
newsitem.headline: NYSE to suspend, delist Prime Motor.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange on Friday said it would suspend trading in Prime Motor Inns LP stock before the market opening on June 20.
The exchange said that following the suspension, it will make an application to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to delist Prime Motor.
The exchange said it took the action because Prime Motor no longer meets its listing criteria.
The NYSE also said that it may suspend the company's stock at an earlier date if it receives information that Prime Motor does not meet the listing criteria of another securities marketplace.
Prime Motor has said it is seeking to transfer the trading of its stock to another exchange.
